title: Stockflethweg, Hamburg
description:
❤️ This spacious and modern apartment is perfect for business travelers seeking a home away from home! 🌠

Welcome to this spacious studio apartment in Langenhorn, perfect for business travelers looking for a home away from home. Located on the Ground floor, this apartment offers modern furnishings and can accommodate up to 2 guests. 

The living area exudes a calm and functional vibe, designed for both relaxation and productivity. Unwind after a day of meetings with your favorite shows on TV. Step into the separate, fully equipped kitchen—a true chef's delight. With modern appliances, including an oven and a spacious fridge, plus all the necessary cooking supplies, this kitchen makes preparing meals an absolute pleasure. A bathroom with a refreshing shower completes this inviting and convenient space, providing the perfect relaxing base for your stay.

📍Location:
Living in Langenhorn means enjoying a green and family-friendly part of Hamburg with a relaxed suburban feel. Spacious parks, local shops, and good schools make it ideal for everyday comfort, while excellent U-Bahn connections ensure you’re quickly in the city center.

📩 Reach out today for more information — your new space is waiting for you!

title: Am Hasenberge, Hamburg
description:
*Built in 2023- New Furniture- Next to the River and Hamburg city park*
*Suitable for families and professionals with 2-4 family members*
This apartment is located in the first floor of a new built building (2023) in a very nice and friendly neighborhood in Alsterdord. The place is next to the Alster river and has a wonderful access to everywhere in the city (city center, airport, supermarkets, shopping malls, etc.) by direct train (train station is next to the building).
The place is equipped with new furniture and it includes everything you would need for a comfortable stay! Just don’t forget to bring your boat!:)
The kitchen is equipped with all the kitchen appliances (dishwasher, stove and oven, hood, combi-refrigerator) with high quality brand (Siemens) and the whole apartment is equipped with the floor heating.
There are two big balconies in the apartment with the view to the river and beautiful green park along the river! you can also use the garden at the house with direct access to the Alster for your relaxation.
There is a double bed, closet, and a desk in the bedroom, and the place is a friendly environment for home-office. 
This residential complex offers picturesque views and presents itself as a true dream property.

Equipment:
- Handleless modern fitted kitchen with fully integrated electrical appliances from the manufacturer Siemens incl. refrigerator / freezer combination, oven, hob, extractor hood and dishwasher
- Real wood parquet
- Adjustable underfloor heating in all rooms 
- Video intercom system
- Floor-to-ceiling windows with triple glazing (sound proof)
- Bathroom armature from Grohe
- Utility room in the apartment
- A large private storage room inside the apartment
- Parking space in underground parking
- Bicycle storage in the underground garage
- Elevator
- Combined heat and power unit (low energy consumption)
- Energy-efficient construction (KfW 55)

Location:
The property is located in the popular district of Ohlsdorf in Hamburg. 
- Within walking distance of the property are several bus lines and the U/S train station Ohlsdorf with train lines (U1, S1, S11):
- Reaching Hamburg airport by direct train in only 4 minutes!
- Despite the quiet and relaxing neighborhood you can also reach the city center by a direct train in 16 minutes! 
- The direct access to the Alster and the proximity to the Ohlsdorfer Park creates an idyllic atmosphere and allows fairytale walks in the immediate vicinity. 
-In the immediate vicinity you will find a newly built large indoor swimming pool as well as various restaurants, bakeries, cafes, doctors and supermarkets.

title: Buurredder, Hamburg
description:

This stylish and fully furnished apartment is located on the first floor of a newly constructed building in a quiet and friendly green neighborhood. The apartment will be available for rent from September 1st, 2025.

This apartment offers both comfort and convenience – ideal for professionals, couples, or small families.

title: Staudenweg, Hamburg
description:
Das Apartment verfügt über ca. 30 qm und ist liebevoll und praktisch ausgestattet. 
Die Wohnung steht komfortablen Schlafgelegenheiten (Doppelbet), vollausgestatteter Küche, Dusche, WC (mit Fußbodenheizung), TV, elektrische Rollläden an den Fenstern, eigenem Hauseingang und WLan voll möbliert zur Verfügung und ist wahrhaftig ein kleines Juwel! Ein Waschcenter befindet sich in 500m Entfernung.
Das Apartment in Hamburg besticht insgesamt durch seine verkehrsgünstige Lage.
Nur etwa 500 Meter zur U-Bahn oder zu günstigen Leih-PKW(Car2Go), die Sie überall in der Innenstadt kostenlos abstellen können. Am Bahnhof Ochsenzoll finden Sie auch diverse Lokale, einen Bäcker, einen REWE-Markt (07.00 - 22.00 Uhr) und vieles mehr. Aldi (07.00 – 21.00 Uhr) und Rossmann sind nur 100 Meter entfernt.

title: Eckloßberg, Hamburg

title: Wellingsbütteler Landstraße, Hamburg
description:
This bright and spacious apartment offers a special temporary home – ideal for anyone who wants to enjoy Hamburg’s natural surroundings without missing out on the advantages of city life.

Highlights at a glance:

- Unobstructed views of greenery – completely private with a stunning view into the treetops
- Two terraces with sunshine throughout the day
- Open-plan, fully equipped kitchen
- Bedroom with ensuite bathroom
- Separate study – perfect for working from home
- Direct access to the Alster hiking trail and adjacent forest
- Tastefully furnished with great attention to detail – move in and feel at home

The apartment is quietly located, surrounded by nature, with direct access to the Alster river path. Whether it’s walking, jogging, or simply taking a deep breath – relaxation begins right outside your door.

Despite the peaceful, green setting, the U1 (Klein Borstel) and S1 (Kornweg) stations are within walking distance. The airport and central districts are also just a short drive away – ideal for business travelers or commuters.

Thoughtful design, plenty of natural light, and a special atmosphere make this place much more than just a temporary stay.
